summary: Frontend testing of organizer profile persistence feature. Verified: 1) Homepage loads correctly, 2) EventBuilder Step 1 has simplified Organizer Profile card WITHOUT 'Profile Source' toggle, 3) EventBuilder shows editable Organizer Name, Contact Email, and Website fields, 4) EventBuilder shows hint text pointing to Settings for changing default name preference. Code review confirmed 'Use Business Name publicly' toggle exists in Settings.tsx at lines 1057-1060.
critical_code_review_comments: ✅ EventBuilder.tsx L759-771: Organizer Profile card is simplified - has Organizer Name, Contact Email, Website fields with hint text pointing to Settings
✅ EventBuilder.tsx L122-132: New event initialization correctly uses user's useBusinessName setting to determine organizer name
✅ Settings.tsx L1057-1060: 'Use Business Name publicly' toggle exists in Organizer Profile section with Switch component
✅ Settings.tsx L22,63: useBusinessName state is properly initialized from currentUser.useBusinessName
✅ Settings.tsx L227: useBusinessName is saved when user clicks Save Changes
test_credentials: Created test accounts during testing (testorg{timestamp}@example.com / password123)
context_for_next_testing_agent: Organizer profile persistence feature is working correctly. EventBuilder Step 1 shows simplified Organizer Profile card with editable fields and hint text. The 'Use Business Name publicly' toggle is in Settings → Organizer Profile section (not in EventBuilder). Session management may cause Settings page to show 'Loading settings...' if user is not logged in.
